title: Earthy Exotic Portuguese Fregola Nigiri
description: This dish combines the earthy flavors of fregola with the exotic twist of Portuguese monsoon spices, all wrapped up in a sattvic friendly nigiri shape. It features a glassy jelly texture from the use of agar agar.
instructions: Toast the fregola in a dry pan until lightly browned.
In a large pot, combine the toasted fregola, agar agar, monsoon spices, coconut oil, and salt.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the fregola is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature.
Once cooled, shape the mixture into small nigiri shapes.
Wrap each nigiri shape in a norib sheet.
Serve the nigiri chilled, garnished with sesame seeds.
